“L’Atelier des Papillons” marks an important new chapter in the history of Pièce Unique. For the first time, the collection expands beyond handbags and gilets to embrace footwear, reaffirming Roger Vivier’s founding identity as one of the great shoemakers in fashion history.
1. Légère — Silk organdy petals fade into a soft gradient of crystal, sequins and goose feathers, as if caught mid-bloom.
2. Queue d’Hirondelle — Across yellow satin, threedimensional wings ornamented of yellow and jet black microbeads are poised for flight with an antennae catching the light.
3. Charbonnière — Matte black suede meets a mirror-blue heel, sharp and graphic as a bird in flight.
#GherardoFelloni

British Pakistani Honoured at UK Parliament for Creating Jobs and Building a $1 Billion Company in Pakistan
British Pakistani entrepreneur Shafiq Akbar was honoured at the UK Parliament for his leadership in real estate, economic empowerment, and diaspora engagement.
Presented by Lord Shaffaq Mohammed, the award recognised Akbar’s contributions, including:
– Creating thousands of jobs in Pakistan
– Driving the digital transformation of Pakistan’s real estate sector
– Leading major developments, including Islamabad Downtown and four Marriott Hotels
– Building a $1 billion company to position Pakistan as a global PropTech leader
A Cambridge graduate and former financial advisor in the UK, Akbar returned to Pakistan to launch ventures such as IMARAT Group, Graana. com, Agency21, and PropMax. ai—focused on innovation, transparency, and sustainable development.
In his remarks, he called on overseas Pakistanis to bring their global expertise home:
“This award is a tribute to the power of connection—between countries, identity, and real impact.”
The ceremony also featured virtual messages from Chairman Youth Parliament of Pakistan, Abrar-ul-Haq, and Minister for Climate Change, Romina Khurshid Alam, who commended Akbar’s leadership in youth empowerment and diaspora mobilisation.
